rules.value: SVG artwork rasterized locally without scripts or external resources.
rules.reason: Explicitly stated in brandbook findings for logo usage.

rules.value: UI built like studio gear: black canvas, square corners, hairlines, mono labels, lime light. Waveforms are full-round pills (2-3px gap), height from peaks, 14-15% floor. Unplayed pills are track color (15-25%), played are lime. Playhead is 1px lime line with soft glow.
rules.reason: Directly from brandbook describing product UI and waveform appearance.
Derived from the campaign's immutable brand colors (lime #DFFF00 on near-black).

rules.value: Minimum 16px micro grid (space-4) for gutters on phones, 32px (space-8) on desktop. Touch targets >= 40px (touch-target).
rules.reason: Inferred from existing grid system and accessibility touch-target rules to define consistent safe areas across placements.

rules.value: Physical and quick: entrances cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1) over 0.6s (staggered 40-50ms). Waveform pills grow over 0.7s (3-6ms apart). Drawers slide from right in 0.25s with a 0.25s fade. Loops/pulses indicate live status.
rules.reason: Detailed motion system described in brandbook findings.

rules.value: Backgrounds and people (musicians, rooms) may be generated, but product UI must be authentic. No real people, brands, instrument logos, or DAW interfaces.
rules.reason: Explicitly stated in the campaign brief's synthesis instructions.

rules.value: Direct, mechanical-confident, specific. Built by musicians, for musicians. Avoid marketing-soft, developer-speak, alarmed, or cute tones. Never promise what product can't do.
rules.reason: Detailed brand tone guidelines from brandbook findings.

rules.value: Music for snippets uses 'Night Drive' or similar fictional demo content. No third-party music, instrument logos, DAW trademarks, or competitor names. Audio export is WAV only.
rules.reason: Inferred from product capabilities (WAV only), demo content, and prohibitions against third-party/competitor content.

rules.value: No shadows in page flow. No emoji in UI. No literal px values in styling (use named styles). No competitor names, DAW trademarks/logos.
rules.reason: Explicitly stated as a prohibition in brandbook findings and C1 immutables.

The interface is built like studio gear — black canvas, square corners, hairlines, mono labels, and one lime light that says what is happening now.

Everything here mirrors the product's own UI kit (`/uikit`); when a component and a rule disagree, the rule wins.

Destructive actions hide one step deep. Delete lives in the ⋮ menu, in destructive, behind a confirmation; deleting a space or project asks for its name.

Honesty. No competitor names anywhere — copy, metadata or keywords. No numbers or promises the product can't back. No emoji in the UI.

Nothing in the page flow casts a shadow.

Waveforms: Pills, never rectangles: full-round bars with a 2px gap (3px on phones), height from the audio peaks with a 14–15% floor.

Unplayed waveform pills are the track colour (or `foreground`) at 15–25%; played pills turn `lime`.

The playhead is a 1px `lime` line with a soft glow (`shadow-playhead`) and a small triangle on the ruler.

Never set it in capitals, never colour the whole word lime, never place it on a lime surface.

No emoji anywhere in the UI.

sonicdesk logo and wordmark ("sonicdesk." with lime dot), brand colours (lime #DFFF00 on near-black), typefaces (Archivo, JetBrains Mono), product UI layout and labels (snippet window, section ribbon, length chips 5–30s, Export snippet button), feature behaviour as described in the claims.

No competitor names or DAW trademarks/logos.

sonicdesk. is a workspace where a band keeps its songs: every take lossless, every version kept, comments on the exact bars.

Direct, never decorative. Built by musicians, for musicians. Mechanical-confident, like good studio gear. Specific — bars, takes, versions, not "items".

Never marketing-soft ("Unleash your creativity!"), never developer-speak, never alarmed (a slow song is not an error), never cute or promising what the product can't do.
